synthesis_decision.rationale: [blinded_slot:candidate_b->antithesis] Both candidates met the 2.5 m/s sound-speed and 0.85 mm Hausdorff limits on both public scans, with nearly identical worst errors of about 0.0101 m/s and 0.00245 mm. No mechanical benchmark metrics were reported. B also verified the required output schema and x-ordering in an isolated process. Across angular receiver holdouts on the real scans, B's worst errors were 0.0192 m/s and 0.00319 mm; with pin timing fixed during refinement, speed error still stayed below 0.043 m/s. | B wins on real-data validation, not synthetic pass counts. Its angular holdouts

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: Source–pin–sensor two-leg paths alone account for the measured pin wavefront.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: On the two public scans, direct plus two-leg atoms left RMS residuals of 0.1657 and 0.1675; direct plus a pin-to-sensor atom reached 0.0799 and 0.0800.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: The measured coherent nuisance has path length independent of absorber location; a two-leg gate misses it.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Initialize with the measured pin wavefront, then fit pin and direct paths jointly and check direct-only speed recovery.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: Fixed nominal sound speed is adequate for direct-wave focusing across the observed bath temperatures.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: Nominal-speed grid focusing missed by 2.926 mm and 33.061 mm; calibrating speed from the pin reduced both errors to 0.354 mm on the same grid.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: A shared speed error shifts predicted arrivals across the ring, allowing sidelobes or unrelated peaks to outrank a true focus.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Seed from the pin and jointly refine sound speed and both absorber positions, profiling out signed channel amplitudes.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: Subtracting the first grid-centered pulse leaves the second source as the strongest residual focus.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: Six of twelve weak-source stresses failed; in case 3 both estimates clustered around the stronger source, leaving a 48.46 mm Hausdorff error.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: A slightly miscentered strong pulse leaves a coherent timing residual. Near-overlapping candidate atoms also share energy with the already fitted pin and first pulse.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Refine the first arrival continuously before subtraction and score new candidates using their energy outside the fitted span.
